edges.reason: msg.sender is written into the owner state variable in the Owner constructor, defining privileged control.
msg.sender balance is credited with the initial supply in the Token constructor.
msg.sender balance is read and debited inside Token.transfer.
msg.sender balance is required before writing allowance in approve.
msg.sender is forwarded to the untrusted recipient in approveAndCall.
msg.sender allowance is the authorization basis for transferFrom.
msg.sender balance and frozen status are checked in EXToken.transfer.
msg.sender allowance is consumed in EXToken.transferFrom.
msg.value and msg.sender balances drive the buy exchange.
msg.sender is both the token source and the ether recipient of msg.sender.send in sell.
msg.sender is the recipient of msg.sender.send in withdraw.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender to owner before transferOwnership executes.
onlyOwner modifier gates freezeAccount with msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier gates setPrices with msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier gates setCouldTrade with msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier gates stopTrade with msg.sender.
Untrusted msg.sender receives ether through the low level send in sell.
Untrusted msg.sender receives ether through the low level send in withdraw.
transferOwnership rewrites the privileged owner variable.
Token constructor mints balances into balanceOf.
Token constructor sets totalSupply.
Token.transfer mutates sender and recipient balances.
approve writes the allowance mapping.
transferFrom mutates balances of _from and _to.
transferFrom decreases the caller allowance.
EXToken constructor reassigns the deployer balance.
EXToken constructor sets the initial buyPrice.
EXToken constructor sets the initial sellPrice.
EXToken.transfer mutates balances after the frozen check.
EXToken.transferFrom mutates balances after the frozen check.
EXToken.transferFrom decreases the caller allowance.
freezeAccount writes the frozenAccount mapping under onlyOwner.
setPrices writes buyPrice under onlyOwner.
setPrices writes sellPrice under onlyOwner.
buy moves balances between the contract and the buyer.
sell moves balances between the seller and the contract.
setCouldTrade enables trading under onlyOwner.
stopTrade disables trading under onlyOwner.
approveAndCall reaches the external receiveApproval call on an arbitrary contract.
sell reaches the low level send of revenue to the caller.
withdraw reaches the low level send of the requested amount.
buy executes unchecked msg.value * RATE / buyPrice arithmetic.
sell executes unchecked amount * sellPrice / RATE arithmetic.
transfer evaluates balanceOf[_to] + _value which can overflow.
buy evaluates balanceOf[msg.sender] + amount which can overflow.
setCouldTrade evaluates balanceOf[this] + amountInWeiDecimalIs18 which can overflow.
stopTrade evaluates balanceOf[msg.sender] + _remain which can overflow.
The untrusted recipient regains control during receiveApproval and can re-enter approveAndCall before its state settles.
The ether send gives msg.sender control to re-enter sell before balances are fully settled.
The ether send lets msg.sender re-enter withdraw repeatedly.
initialSupply parameter drives the minted balance and totalSupply in the Token constructor.
newOwner parameter is written into the privileged owner variable.
_to parameter selects the balance mapping entry credited in transfer.
_value parameter is the amount debited and credited in transfer.
_spender parameter selects the allowance entry written in approve.
_value parameter is the allowance amount written in approve.
The TokenRecipient cast of the untrusted _spender is the target of the receiveApproval call.
Untrusted _extraData is forwarded verbatim into the external receiveApproval call.
_value of approveAndCall is passed into the internal approve call.
_spender of approveAndCall is passed into the internal approve call.
_from parameter selects the balance debited in transferFrom.
_to parameter selects the balance credited in transferFrom.
_value parameter is the allowance consumed in transferFrom.
_target parameter selects the frozenAccount entry written by freezeAccount.
freeze parameter is the boolean value stored in frozenAccount.
newSellPrice parameter is written to the price used by sell.
newBuyPrice parameter is written to the price used by buy.
Unchecked msg.value * RATE / buyPrice result becomes the local amount in buy.
Sell amount parameter feeds the unchecked multiplication with sellPrice.
Unchecked amount * sellPrice / RATE result becomes the revenue sent in sell.
withdraw amount parameter is the value passed to the low level send to msg.sender.
setCouldTrade amount parameter feeds the overflow prone balance addition.
stopTrade _remain local feeds the overflow prone balance addition.
tokenName parameter is stored in the name state variable.
tokenSymbol parameter is stored in the symbol state variable.
decimalUnits parameter is stored in the decimals state variable.
standardStr parameter is stored in the standard state variable.

normalization_plan.reason: initialSupply is a constructor parameter fully consumed by Token.Token minting logic.
tokenName is a constructor parameter written to token metadata.
decimalUnits is a constructor parameter written to token metadata.
tokenSymbol is a constructor parameter written to token metadata.
standardStr is a constructor parameter written to token metadata.
newOwner is the only input of transferOwnership and becomes the privileged owner.
_to only identifies the destination balance inside Token.transfer.
_value only carries the transferred amount inside Token.transfer.
_spender only selects the allowance key inside approve.
_value only carries the allowance amount inside approve.
_spender is passed straight into the internal approve call of approveAndCall.
_value is passed straight into the internal approve call of approveAndCall.
_extraData is untrusted calldata forwarded by approveAndCall to the recipient.
spender is the untrusted TokenRecipient target of the external receiveApproval call.
_from only selects the debited balance inside transferFrom.
_to only selects the credited balance inside transferFrom.
_value only carries the transferred amount inside transferFrom.
_target only selects the frozenAccount key written by freezeAccount.
freeze is the boolean stored by freezeAccount.
newSellPrice is only assigned to sellPrice by setPrices.
newBuyPrice is only assigned to buyPrice by setPrices.
amount is the direct result of the unchecked msg.value * RATE / buyPrice multiplication.
amountInWeiDecimalIs18 is the sell input that drives the revenue computation.
amount is a local copy of the sell input used for balance updates in sell.
revenue is the direct result of the unchecked amount * sellPrice / RATE multiplication.
amount is the exact value passed to the low level send in withdraw.
amountInWeiDecimalIs18 is the input of the balance arithmetic in setCouldTrade.
_remain is the local contract balance variable used in the stopTrade addition.
